text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I'm heading to my office before<n>training when...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Okay, okay, I'll make this the last<n>one! Hehe.
Hehehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Gah! How long have you been here,<n>Trainer?! Why
didn't you say<n>anything?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Ahem. I have received a letter from<n>a fan. But
look, look! Check it out!<n>Isn't this great?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The letter she shows me is<n>addressed to "Big Sis
Ines Fujin."
choice_data_list: Is this from your little sister?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Nope, it's from a fan. But she says<n>I'm like a big
sister to her!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
This makes me so happy! It's like<n>I'm family to
her, and I'm supporting<n>her right back...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"You're so kind and cool... I wish I<n>had a big sister
like you."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Hehehe. "I wish I had a big sister<n>like you," she
said...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You know, I always thought that the<n>reason I run is
because I love it...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But when I look at this letter and<n>stuff... I start to
think it'd be nice if I<n>could run in a way that made
the<n>audience think of me as family.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm, maybe I'm asking for too<n>much?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks. But if I want to make<n>that happen, I'll
need to give today's<n>training double the usual
effort!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: All right, Trainer! I'm ready when you<n>are!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to her fan letter, Ines Fujin<n>stays energized
the whole day!
